stories.title: North Wales ketamine campaign launched as hospital admissions climb
stories.summary: Emergency department admissions linked to ketamine in North Wales rose from 241 in 2023 to 412 in 2025, an increase of 71% in two years. The figures have been released as organisations across the region launch a campaign aimed at young people using the Class B drug. The campaign, called I Wish Someone Had Told

stories.title: Taxis found in dangerous condition during Chester checks
stories.summary: Two taxi licences have been suspended after vehicles were found to be in a dangerous condition during a licensing operation in Chester at the weekend. stories.title: North Wales Police issue warning after fire started in Wepre Park area
stories.summary: Park rangers put out a fire in the Wepre Park area of Connah’s Quay after it smouldered overnight. North Wales Police said the fire was started the previous day and was still burning when it was found the following morning. Rangers reached it before it spread further. The force released a photograph of the scene

stories.title: Man airlifted from Mostyn Docks after coastguard rescue
stories.summary: An injured casualty was airlifted from Mostyn Docks on Sunday afternoon after coastguard teams decided a helicopter was the safest way to get them off the site. Flint Coastguard Rescue Team led the response and was joined by the Llandudno team. Crews treated the casualty at the scene before calling in the coastguard helicopter Rescue

stories.title: Mold pupils win £150 for recycled sculpture of town’s Spring Clean mascot
stories.summary: Pupils at a Mold primary school have won £150 after building a sculpture of the town’s Spring Clean mascot entirely out of recycled materials.
